info.title: AdvocateMate API
info.description: Backend for the AdvocateMate Andhra Pradesh High Court advocate app. Court data is retrieved server-side from public APHC sources (aphc.gov.in Hcdbs pages and the Lexika chatbot). These /api/v1 routes are AdvocateMate's own API, not APHC endpoints.
